items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Thomas worked with us, because he had that period away from school or whatever it was.

ctx.x: So we were going back to make the Five Spot gig, which we considered a very good gig. And we were picking up things as we go, but we had this opportunity to go out and make that so we go ahead and make it.

Wes had some tunes worked out, Wes and Buddy's tunes were great for my....., working out songs for the Brothers. We had a two-week engagement at the Five Spot and we end up eleven weeks. We ended up working the Five Spot for eleven weeks. We changed drummers about five times; we had five different drummers. Bobby Thomas.....
Why was it so difficult to settle on somebody?
